Comments:
-Layout (9.5/10): The overall structure closely matches: two-row blue header, centered hero banner, overlapping search form, checkbox options, and offers section. Minor differences exist in header spacing and the exact width/positioning of search fields.
-Elements (14/15): Nearly all major elements are present and correctly placed, including navigation items, hero text, credit card graphic, CTA button, search controls, checkboxes, and offer cards. Some icons and small controls differ slightly in appearance.
-Content and Text (39/40): Text content is highly accurate, including the headline, supporting copy, navigation labels, search labels, and offers section. There are only very minor differences in text wrapping, button copy visibility, or positioning.
-Style (14/15): Colors, typography, imagery, borders, buttons, and overall Booking.com visual language are very closely reproduced. Small deviations appear in icon styling, font rendering, header vertical alignment, and image cropping.
-Overall (19/20): An extremely close recreation with strong visual and content fidelity. The remaining differences are mostly small spacing, sizing, and rendering variations.

Score: 95.5/100
